verdict.rationale: Bevy's evidence describes a code-first Rust ECS engine (components, systems, scenes-as-data, hot reloading) but nothing about a visual editor with viewport, inspector, or prefab/scene composition UI; comment bevy-comm-8 even suggests users hope NOT to be forced into an in-engine editor, and probes show no official tooling filling this gap. Missing for full/partial credit: any first-party viewport/inspector GUI, prefab authoring workflow, or scene-composition editor.
